newsitem.title: USA: First Union Real Estate stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: First Union Real Estate stake held by group.

text.p: A group including Apollo Real Estate Advisors II L.P. said Monday it holds 219,400 preferred shares of First Union Real Estate Equity and Mortgage Investments, representing 9.54 percent of the class outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $7.3 million for the stake and holds it for investment.
It said it bought the stake between November 11 and 25 at prices ranging from $30.1196 to $34.375 a share.
The sole general partner of Apollo is Apollo Real Estate Capital Advisors II Inc, which is controlled by a group led by investor Leon Black.
First Union Real Estate is based in Cleveland, Ohio.
